name: Adult Red Dragon
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If fails save, can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Three attacks: one bite + two claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing + 3 (1d6) fire.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.text: Each creature within 120 ft: WIS save DC 19 or frightened 1 min.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: 90-ft cone: 26 (9d6) fire. DC 21 DEX half; or 13 (3d8) fire ongoing.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Cost 2)
legendaryActions.text: Flies up to half speed; each within 15 ft: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning. DC 20 STR or prone + pushed 20 ft.
